bullets.title: like this
bullets.note: , I wondered if ALC might play a role. I only experienced this when taking ALC in the later afternoon or evening, and daily total consumption never exceeded 1,500mg. After finding a few reports [like this](https://el2.convertkit-mail2.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohgp32w/07twh9holoxg54/aHR0cHM6Ly9wZGZzLnNlbWFudGljc2Nob2xhci5vcmcvZGE1MS9kYWQ2NDE1YWJjODU2YjA2NDcyYjhhNmJiNjcxZjU3N2EzNDAucGRm), I decided to call it quits with my protocol. Thus far, I have found ALC to produce unpleasantly vivid dreams to a much greater extent than, say, galantamine or huperzine-A, which enhance vividness but don’t seem to create the same degree of negative tone. Of course, this is an N of 1 (single subject) amateur hour, but the contrast has been both remarkable and remarkably consistent. I’d be curious to hear if anyone else has experienced something similar. And be careful with those cholinergic neurons...
